Variants.Content: Placing a child in foster care can both foster camaraderie and discipline an unreliable ally. The lord calls it education and trust. The mother may only remember parting, while the child learns another set of rules in someone else's castle and always remembers why he was sent there.

Entry Fostering and Hostages Placing a child in foster care can both foster camaraderie and discipline an unreliable ally. The lord calls it education and trust. The mother may only remember parting, while the child learns another set of rules in someone else's castle and always remembers why he was sent there. Whether it is valid depends on who can grant the rights, collect the consideration, and actually make the judgment come to fruition in the event of default.

Entry Fostering and Hostages Placing a child in foster care can both foster camaraderie and discipline an unreliable ally. The lord calls it education and trust. The mother may only remember parting, while the child learns another set of rules in someone else's castle and always remembers why he was sent there. If a rule is practiced over and over again, it will find its way into rituals, crafts, and prayers; if it is sustained only by fear, cracks will show at the onset of a crisis.

Entry Fostering and Hostages Placing a child in foster care can both foster camaraderie and discipline an unreliable ally. The lord calls it education and trust. The mother may only remember parting, while the child learns another set of rules in someone else's castle and always remembers why he was sent there. They remember taxes, grain, labor, relief and who can speak for them; these grand names will eventually fall on the family's rice pot.
